# REVERSE HOST-HINT CANDIDATES &mdash; UNADJUDICATED

**Generated by `tools/pastpapers/build_reuse_map.py` from `specs/*.json`. Do not hand-edit.**

## THIS IS A QUEUE FOR A HUMAN. NOTHING HERE IS A DONOR.

Every row below is a pair that the **third-party host's printed annotation** links and that **MIW has not adjudicated**. A host hint is discovery-only provenance: the 2026 review found it over-claiming and under-claiming in both directions, and its bare-month tokens link wholly unrelated questions. Nothing in this document is a recurrence family, a reuse tier, a donor or a preferred donor, and nothing here is rendered to a candidate. `build_families` and `donor_readiness` produce identical output whether or not this document exists.

A row becomes real only when an author **reads both questions** and writes `reused_from`. At that moment the adjudicated layer picks it up in **both** directions on its own &mdash; that layer has always been undirected, and `--self-test` case 9 holds it to that.

## Why the queue is needed at all

The host prints a CUMULATIVE table: each token names the current sitting or an earlier one. Over this corpus that is not a convention but a structural fact &mdash; **604 resolved tokens, and not one of them points forward.** MIW solves newest-paper-first, so the annotation is only ever legible in the direction production is not travelling. When `QP2509-Q6` (September 2025) was authored, `QP2601-Q2` (January 2026) was already built and set the same examiner task; the only machine-readable trace of the link sat on `QP2601`'s record pointing backwards, so `QP2509-Q6` derived as tier C with no donor and a human found it by hand.

## Token accounting

Every token is accounted for. A token that cannot be resolved is **counted here, never dropped**: a silently discarded token reads as "no candidate" when it means "not looked at".
